# Abdullah Seyda Aksakal — Fractional CTO & Principal AI Architect

> 16 years building and leading engineering organizations for enterprise and high-growth clients, including Uber, Walmart, NTT Data, Domino's Pizza, DoorDash, Grubhub and Instacart. Specializes in distributed systems, agentic AI and LLM platforms, cloud-native infrastructure, and DevSecOps.

Location: Istanbul, Türkiye. Engagements: fractional, project-based, full-time.
Contact: via GitHub (https://github.com/aseydaaksakal).

## Open-source projects

- [mcp-toolkit](https://github.com/aseydaaksakal/mcp-toolkit): Open-source Model Context Protocol server library (Python/Go) for exposing internal systems to LLM agents.
- [rag-eval](https://github.com/aseydaaksakal/rag-eval): Evaluation harness for production RAG systems (Ragas-compatible): retrieval-quality regression tests and hallucination-rate tracking.
